title: Week 1: The Stranger

cards.text: It's Founders' Day. The parade float is a papier-mache you. It's on fire. Slightly.

options.label: Ride the float anyway
options.reaction: You waved the whole time. While smoking.

options.label: Buy a new float
options.reaction: The new you has two eyes the same size.

game.title: Steer the burning float
game.flop: You steered the float into the fire station. Ironic.

cards.text: Stormy Steve predicts 'weather'. He will not say which kind. He looks worried.

options.label: Buy sandbags
options.reaction: Sandbags! Good for most weather. Not all.

options.label: Ignore Steve
options.reaction: That's what the last mayor did.

game.title: Bag the rain, dodge the lightning
game.flop: Steve was struck twice. He says it's "data".

cards.text: Someone slid a note under your door: 'LOOK IN THE BASEMENT.' The handwriting is very neat.

options.label: Go and look
options.reaction: Boxes. Hundreds of boxes. All marked 'DO NOT COUNT'.

options.label: Burn the note
options.reaction: A second note arrives. It says 'RUDE.'

game.title: Match the mysterious notes
game.flop: You matched two grocery lists. One says "BASEMENT".

cards.text: A bear is in my office. It says you two need to talk.

options.label: Apologise to the bear
options.reaction: The bear accepts. It wants a column.

options.label: Wrestle it for real
options.reaction: You lost. But we got photos.

game.title: Arm-wrestle the bear
game.flop: The bear won. Then it asked for a rematch. On camera.

cards.text: The power is out. The town is dark. Chad's mansion is still lit. He has 'a guy'.

options.label: Pay Chad's guy
options.reaction: The lights are on. The bill says 'guy stuff'.

options.label: Hand out candles
options.reaction: Cosy. Also four small fires.

options.label: Sit in the dark
options.reaction: Very atmospheric. Someone has started telling ghost stories.

game.title: Rewire the fuse box
game.flop: You rewired the town backwards. The fridges are warm.

cards.text: The basement boxes are old ballots. From the last election. Every single one says 'Gerald'.

options.label: Tell the town
options.reaction: So the goose won. And nobody said.

options.label: Put the boxes back
options.reaction: You saw nothing. The boxes saw you.

game.title: Sort the old ballots
game.flop: They all say Gerald. You sorted them anyway.

cards.text: The county fair is here. Timmy entered you in the pie contest. As a pie eater. Against Gerald.

options.label: Eat for the town
options.reaction: Second place. To a goose. Still, a medal!

options.label: Decline politely
options.reaction: Gerald wins by default. He's unbearable about it.

game.title: Slice the pies, not the fireworks
game.flop: You sliced a firework. The pie contest is cancelled.

cards.text: Tonight: the mayoral debate. Your opponent is a traffic cone. It is polling well.

options.label: Debate with facts
options.reaction: You won on points. The cone won on charm.

options.label: Debate with insults
options.reaction: 'Orange And Empty,' says Mayor. Crowd gasps.

game.title: Hit your talking points
game.flop: You said "orange" eleven times. The cone looked smug.

cards.text: The Goose Union demands a pond. Inside City Hall. In your office. They've already measured your desk for it.

options.label: Build the pond
options.reaction: Honk. That means thank you. Probably.

options.label: Pond in the park instead
options.reaction: A compromise. We will remember this. Fondly, for now.

options.label: Refuse
options.reaction: The union will hear of this. They are right behind you.

advisors.line: Geese don't pay taxes. I checked.
The children love the geese. The geese do not love the children.

game.title: Lead the geese to the pond
game.flop: You led them into City Hall. They like it there.

cards.text: We need a helicopter. For crime. And also, mostly, for fun. I've already bought the sunglasses.

options.label: Buy it
options.reaction: I call the front seat. Forever.

options.label: Lease one
options.reaction: A rental. Fine. I'm still doing the noises. Chuka-chuka-chuka.

options.label: Promise it next quarter
options.reaction: I'm writing that down. In pen.

advisors.line: It costs four thousand a month just to look at it.
'Chief Buzzes Town.' I'd print that.

game.title: Fly the helicopter through town
game.flop: You parked on the church spire. The vicar is furious.

cards.text: The only snowplow is broken. School road or Chad's shopping street? The other stays buried.

options.label: Plow the school road
options.reaction: The children can learn again. Chad is calling. I'm not answering.

options.label: Plow Chad Street
options.reaction: The shops are open. The school is an igloo now.

options.label: Rent a second plow
options.reaction: Two plows. I need to sit down.

advisors.line: The children are sledding to school. On each other.
Snow is bad for business. Unless you sell snow.

game.title: Plow ahead, hop the snowmen
game.flop: You plowed a snowman. It was Steve. He's fine. Cold.

cards.text: Put a casino in the library. Books are just slow slot machines. The librarian already counts cards. And people.

options.label: Build the casino
options.reaction: You won't regret this. Others will.

options.label: Refuse
options.reaction: Fine. Enjoy your free knowledge.

options.label: Casino night, once a year
options.reaction: One night. I'll make it count.

advisors.line: The books already know who wins.
I'd have to arrest the librarian. Again.

game.title: Break the bank at blackjack
game.flop: You broke the library instead. Quietly.

cards.text: The Bugle needs a front page. Can we say you wrestled a bear? Not a big one. Medium bear. Believable bear.

options.label: Yes, I wrestled a bear
options.reaction: Wonderful. Did you win? Never mind, you won.

options.label: Tell the truth
options.reaction: Honesty. On a Tuesday. Bold.

advisors.line: Lying about bears is a crime. I just made that a crime.
Did the bear have a name?

game.title: Wrestle the bear, for the photo
game.flop: The bear won. It's on the front page, grinning.

cards.text: Every great town has a giant something. I have drawings of a spoon. Don't ask why. The spoon knows why.

options.label: Build the spoon
options.reaction: It faces north. That part matters.

options.label: A normal-sized spoon
options.reaction: You've made a spoon. Congratulations.

options.label: No spoon
options.reaction: That's what they want you to say.

advisors.line: Tourists love a big thing. I'll sell small versions of it.
A spoon. With our money. I feel faint.

game.title: Raise the spoon, piece by piece
game.flop: It's a giant fork now. Nobody ordered a fork.

cards.text: The school has one textbook. It's about boats. We are four hundred miles from water. The children can all tie knots.

options.label: Build a new school
options.reaction: The PTA approves. We have never said that before.

options.label: Promise it by spring
options.reaction: Spring. I'll bring a calendar.

options.label: Buy a second book
options.reaction: It's also about boats.

advisors.line: Fifty thousand. I'll be under my desk.
I like the boat book.

game.title: Build the school
game.flop: The school leans. The children lean with it.

cards.text: The Bugle wants a TV station. Print is dying. I'd like to watch it happen in colour, with adverts.

options.label: Build the station
options.reaction: You're on at six. Wear a tie.

options.label: Lend her the roof
options.reaction: The antenna is mostly safe.

options.label: Refuse
options.reaction: Then tomorrow's headline writes itself.

advisors.line: I'd buy ad time. All of it.
She'll film my parking.

game.title: Follow the director's cues
game.flop: You read the stage directions aloud. 'Mayor smiles.'

cards.text: We could put parking meters on Main Street. People will hate it. The budget will weep with joy. I'll weep either way.

options.label: Install meters
options.reaction: Coins. Lovely, countable coins.

options.label: Meters for visitors only
options.reaction: How do we know who's a visitor? Never mind.

options.label: Free parking forever
options.reaction: Forever is a long time for a budget.

advisors.line: The PTA parks where it likes.
Free parking means chaos. I've seen it.

game.title: Collect the coins
game.flop: You fed your own coins in. All of them.

cards.text: Teens are standing near the fountain. Just standing. One of them is leaning. I want a curfew and a helicopter.

options.label: Curfew at 9 pm
options.reaction: Order. Beautiful, quiet order.

options.label: Fund a youth centre
options.reaction: Now they stand indoors. I'll allow it.

options.label: Let them stand
options.reaction: Then I'm standing near them. Menacingly. With a whistle I'm not afraid to use.

advisors.line: They're good kids. Mostly mine.
I want to stand near the fountain too.

game.title: Round up the loiterers
game.flop: You sent a statue home. The teens are still there.

cards.text: I'd like a tiny tax break. So small you'd need a telescope to see it. I own the telescope shop. Telescopes are also going up.

options.label: Grant the tax break
options.reaction: A pleasure doing business with the public.

options.label: Trade it for a donation
options.reaction: I love a deal. I'll name a bench after you.

options.label: Refuse
options.reaction: I'll remember this at the country club.

advisors.line: We can't afford tiny.
'Mayor Bends For Billionaire.' Or not. Your call.

game.title: Haggle with Chad
game.flop: You haggled yourself upward. Chad sent flowers.

cards.text: Can the town have a Frog Day? I already told everyone there's a Frog Day. Also the frogs. They're coming.

options.label: Fund Frog Day
options.reaction: FROG DAY! FROG DAY!

options.label: Promise Frog Day soon
options.reaction: How many sleeps is soon?

options.label: No Frog Day
options.reaction: I'm telling the frogs.

advisors.line: Honk. (He is against frogs.)
Frogs block traffic. Slowly, but they do.

game.title: Lead the frog parade
game.flop: The frogs led you. Into the police station.

cards.text: Your official portrait is done. The artist painted you as a bear. A good bear. A dignified bear.

options.label: Hang it proudly
options.reaction: The bear looks over City Hall. People salute it.

options.label: Pay for a repaint
options.reaction: Now you're a smaller bear. Progress.

options.label: Burn it
options.reaction: The bear will be remembered. You, less so.

game.title: Find your face among the bears
game.flop: You picked a real bear. It was flattered.

cards.text: The town marathon is today. Nobody trained. The route goes through the bakery. Twice.

options.label: Run it yourself
options.reaction: You finished. You also ate a pie. Nobody's counting.

options.label: Hand out water
options.reaction: Hydrated. Everyone stopped at the bakery anyway.

options.label: Postpone it
options.reaction: Postponed. Three people are still running.

game.title: Run the marathon, hop the pies
game.flop: You stopped for a pie. Then another. Then you lived there.

cards.text: I'd like to run ghost tours of City Hall. The ghost wants a cut. Forty per cent. It's a strong negotiator.

options.label: Give the ghost its cut
options.reaction: The ghost is pleased. It rattled something, warmly.

options.label: Run tours, stiff the ghost
options.reaction: The ghost has unionised. With the geese.

options.label: No ghosts on the payroll
options.reaction: The ghost is haunting HR now.

game.title: Herd the ghosts onto the tour
game.flop: The ghosts toured you. You're in the basement now.

cards.text: Every traffic light went green at once. Nobody has crashed. Everyone is just being polite. Nobody can leave.

options.label: Fix the lights
options.reaction: Red, amber, green. The town wept with relief.

options.label: Leave them green
options.reaction: Society has entered a politeness spiral. It's beautiful.

options.label: Replace them with Barb
options.reaction: Barb is every light now. She's never been happier.

game.title: Get across the polite traffic
game.flop: Everyone waved you across. Into the river.

cards.text: Someone is stealing pies from windowsills. The crumbs lead to the police station. Barb says crumbs are 'circumstantial'.

options.label: Investigate Barb
options.reaction: Barb confessed. To 'a few'. It was eleven.

options.label: Pie locks for everyone
options.reaction: Locks sold out. The thief now steals locks.

options.label: Bake more pies
options.reaction: More pies, more theft. The economy of crumbs grows.

game.title: Sort the pies from the pie thieves
game.flop: You arrested a pie. It had an alibi.

cards.text: My radar picked up a signal from space. It just says 'HONK'. Gerald denies everything. He's packing.

options.label: Reply 'HONK'
options.reaction: They replied. It was rude. Gerald blushed.

options.label: Build a goose shield
options.reaction: The shield works. Also on pigeons. Linda is livid.

options.label: Hand Gerald over
options.reaction: They sent him back. He brought souvenirs.

game.title: Hold off the space geese
game.flop: The space geese landed. They want the pond. Everyone wants the pond.

cards.text: The brass band only knows one song. It's the bin schedule set to music. They'd like a second song, and money.

options.label: Fund music lessons
options.reaction: They know two songs now. Both are about bins.

options.label: Teach them yourself
options.reaction: They now know 'Hot Cross Buns'. Badly. Proudly.

options.label: One song is plenty
options.reaction: They played it at you. For an hour.

game.title: Conduct the brass band
game.flop: The trombone went one way. The band went the other.

cards.text: I want to open an arcade in the old fire station. The fire engine is a ride now. It still has water in it.

options.label: Open the arcade
options.reaction: First ride soaked the deputy mayor. Fun for all.

options.label: Arcade, minus the engine
options.reaction: Fine. The engine is sulking in the car park.

options.label: Firefighters only
options.reaction: The firefighters have the high score. Of course.

game.title: Beat the high score
game.flop: You lost to the fire engine. It doesn't have hands.

cards.text: Someone painted a zebra crossing. With a real zebra. It won't move. Traffic has stopped. The zebra seems content.

options.label: Hire a zebra wrangler
options.reaction: Moved. It's on the roundabout now. Content.

options.label: Make it official
options.reaction: Everyone crosses by the zebra. It nods at them.

options.label: Barb can arrest a zebra
options.reaction: I tried. It looked at me. I'm not okay.

game.title: Walk the zebra across
game.flop: The zebra walked you across. Backwards. Twice.

cards.text: The dog show needs a judge. All forty dogs are Sergeant Biscuit. Barb says that's 'not possible'. It is happening.

options.label: Every dog wins
options.reaction: Forty rosettes. All Biscuit. He's unbearable now.

options.label: Find the real Biscuit
options.reaction: Found him. The other thirty-nine were raccoons.

options.label: Cancel the dog show
options.reaction: Forty Biscuits are sad. That's a lot of sad.

game.title: Spot the dogs, bin the raccoons
game.flop: You gave Best in Show to a raccoon. It accepted.

cards.text: The recycling has piled up so high it has a view. Children are climbing it. One of them has planted a flag.

options.label: Hire sorters
options.reaction: Sorted. The flag was donated to the museum.

options.label: Ship it to Worse Town
options.reaction: Worse Town said thank you. That's the saddest part.

options.label: Call it public art
options.reaction: It won a prize. The prize was more recycling.

game.title: Sort the recycling, bin the cheese
game.flop: You recycled the cheese. It's a bench now. It smells like a bench.

cards.text: The Bugle wants to host karaoke night at City Hall. You'd sing first. You'd sing 'the hard one'.

options.label: Sing the hard one
options.reaction: Your high note broke a window. Front page.

options.label: Lip-sync it
options.reaction: Nobody noticed. Except Marge. Marge always notices.

options.label: No singing in City Hall
options.reaction: The silence is deafening. Marge is writing about it.

game.title: Hit every note of the hard one
game.flop: You hit a note nobody has heard before. Dogs howled.

cards.text: The bus route has become a circle. It's been going round for a week. The passengers have formed a government.

options.label: Add a stop
options.reaction: They got off. Some of them got back on. They miss it.

options.label: Recognise their government
options.reaction: They've declared independence. Seat 14 is the capital.

options.label: Sell the bus
options.reaction: Sold. To the passengers. They're still on it.

game.title: Cross the bus lanes to reach them
game.flop: You got on the wrong bus. You've been elected Seat 9.

cards.text: A wizard has moved into the clock tower. Every hour, instead of chiming, it says 'Ooooh'. He pays rent in sparkles.

options.label: Evict the wizard
options.reaction: He left. The clock still says 'Ooooh'. It's personal now.

options.label: Charge him real rent
options.reaction: He paid in coins. Three of them are frogs.

options.label: Make him town magician
options.reaction: He turned the bins into doves. The doves are bins now.

game.title: Knock the sparkles off the clock
game.flop: You broke the clock. It's now always 'Ooooh' o'clock.

cards.text: Main Street has a pothole so big it has a name. The name is Kevin. Kevin got a letter today. It was a jury summons.

options.label: Fill in Kevin
options.reaction: Goodbye, Kevin. He's survived by a smaller pothole. We've named it Kevin Junior.

options.label: Sell tickets to see Kevin
options.reaction: People are queuing. To look at a hole.

options.label: Leave Kevin alone
options.reaction: Kevin is growing.

advisors.line: Kevin ate my car. I have other cars, but still.
Kevin has more readers than you.

game.title: Jump Kevin in a hatchback
game.flop: Kevin ate the car. And the tow truck. And the plan.

cards.text: I'm giving the town a statue. Of me. It's forty feet tall, it winks, and at noon it says 'You're welcome'.

options.label: Accept the statue
options.reaction: It winks at night too. It also blinks in morse. It says 'CHAD'.

options.label: A statue of someone normal
options.reaction: Who's Brenda? Why does Brenda get a statue?

options.label: No statues
options.reaction: I'll put it just outside town. Facing in.

advisors.line: The children are scared of the wink.
Statues are how they watch us.

game.title: Raise the statue
game.flop: The head is on backwards. It winks at the wall.

cards.text: Raccoons are in the bins. They're organised. They have a leader. I have a sketch. It's a raccoon in a hat and coat.

options.label: Raccoon-proof bins
options.reaction: Let's see them open THAT. Oh. They opened it.

options.label: Night patrols
options.reaction: We patrol all night. People complain about the torches.

options.label: They live here too
options.reaction: You're soft on raccoons. Suspiciously soft.

advisors.line: We... I mean I... think bins should be free. For everyone.
Bins cost money. Everything costs money.

game.title: Repel the raccoon invasion
game.flop: They overran the bins. Dave says he wasn't there.

cards.text: The Bugle's printing press exploded. A little. The town could buy us a new one.

options.label: Buy a new press
options.reaction: Tomorrow's edition will be very kind to you.

options.label: Use the school copier
options.reaction: The paper smells like homework now.

options.label: Not the town's problem
options.reaction: I'll write tomorrow's paper by hand. About you.

advisors.line: That copier is for bake sale flyers.
I could buy the Bugle. Just saying.

game.title: Sort the front pages
game.flop: Tomorrow's paper is all cheese. Marge is calling it a scoop.

cards.text: School lunch is beige. All of it. The children call it 'the paste'. Yesterday the paste was seen leaving on its own.

options.label: Pay for real food
options.reaction: A vegetable! Some of them cried.

options.label: Chad sponsors lunch
options.reaction: 'Chad Nuggets.' The Bugle is having a field day.

options.label: Paste builds character
options.reaction: The PTA has a long memory.

advisors.line: The paste is okay if you don't look.
I tried the paste. I'm suing.

game.title: Chop lunch, not the fire alarm
game.flop: You chopped the fire alarm. Lunch was outside.

cards.text: It's my birthday. Can the whole town have fireworks? I told the whole town yes. I'm eight. I'm in charge now.

options.label: Fireworks for Timmy
options.reaction: BEST. MAYOR. EVER.

options.label: One sparkler
options.reaction: It's... one. It's a small one.

options.label: No fireworks
options.reaction: I'm un-inviting you.

advisors.line: Fireworks are just crime in the sky.
HONK. (Geese hate fireworks.)

game.title: Light the fuses in order
game.flop: One went into the police station. It's fine. It's on fire.

cards.text: I need a weather radar. Right now I lick my finger and hold it up. My finger is tired. It's seen things.

options.label: Buy the radar
options.reaction: I can see rain coming! It's... already raining.

options.label: Promise it next quarter
options.reaction: I'll keep licking the finger till then.

options.label: The finger is fine
options.reaction: Then tomorrow will be... weather.

advisors.line: Twenty thousand to know it's raining.
His guesses fill half my paper.

game.title: Catch the rain, dodge the lightning
game.flop: Steve was struck twice. He says it's 'data'.

cards.text: Open the library at night. The best books only talk after dark.

options.label: Fund the night library
options.reaction: Shh. They're starting.

options.label: Let her run a 'truth club'
options.reaction: We meet Tuesdays. Bring string.

options.label: Libraries close at five
options.reaction: That's what the daytime books want.

advisors.line: Nothing good happens in a library at night.
Can I come? I'm allowed up till eight.

game.title: Shelve the books, bin the ghosts
game.flop: You shelved a ghost. It's in non-fiction. Furious.

cards.text: I'd like to pave the park. For parking. Think of it as a very flat park.

options.label: Pave the park
options.reaction: Smell that? Asphalt. Progress.

options.label: Only half the park
options.reaction: Half a park. Half a car park. Everyone's half happy.

options.label: Hands off the park
options.reaction: Trees don't shop, you know.

advisors.line: HONK. (The pond is in the park.)
Touch that park and the PTA mobilises.

game.title: Park without hitting a goose
game.flop: You parked in a goose's spot. There will be a meeting.

cards.text: Let me hide behind the 'Welcome' sign with a radar gun. I'll wear a bush. I've bought the bush.

options.label: Approve the speed trap
options.reaction: Seventeen tickets before lunch. A good day.

options.label: Warning signs only
options.reaction: A sign. They'll just read it and slow down. Boring.

options.label: No speed trap
options.reaction: Then I'm hiding there anyway. For fun.

advisors.line: You're ticketing my customers.
Twelve thousand, though.

game.title: Clock the speeders
game.flop: You ticketed a goose. It's contesting.

cards.text: The town needs a mascot. Our readers voted. They chose 'Wet Sock'.

options.label: Welcome, Wet Sock
options.reaction: He's damp. He's proud. He's ours.

options.label: Hire a real designer
options.reaction: A smiling building. Readers call it 'Dry Sock'.

options.label: No mascot
options.reaction: You can't cancel Wet Sock. He's already at the school.

advisors.line: I can't put a wet sock on a billboard.
I LOVE WET SOCK.

game.title: Find the mascot's other sock
game.flop: Wet Sock has one sock. Which is, to be fair, the brand.

cards.text: The geese are on strike. Nobody is eating the bugs. The bugs have noticed. The bugs are organising.

options.label: Meet their demands
options.reaction: Honk. (Work resumes.)

options.label: Hire ducks instead
options.reaction: Ducks. You hired DUCKS.

options.label: Wait them out
options.reaction: The bugs are forming their own union.

advisors.line: I can't arrest a goose. I've asked.
Cloudy, with mosquitoes.

game.title: Honk in time with the union
game.flop: You honked off-beat. The union is drafting a statement.

cards.text: I found $30k extra in the budget. It's Chad's. The bank slipped. Nobody knows but me, you, and now this potted plant.

options.label: Keep it quiet
options.reaction: I'm going to be sick. Rich, but sick.

options.label: Give it back
options.reaction: Chad says thanks. He didn't notice it was gone.

options.label: Split it with Chad
options.reaction: A finder's fee. He respects that.

advisors.line: If I find out, that's a front page.
The school roof costs exactly thirty thousand.

game.title: Grab the cash, dodge the receipts
game.flop: You dropped it in the fountain. It's the town's now. Wet.

cards.text: Lovely town. How much for all of it? I'm asking for a friend. The friend is me.

options.label: Name a silly price
options.reaction: A billion and a goose. Interesting. I'll be back.

options.label: Throw him out
options.reaction: I've been thrown out of better towns. This one, actually.

options.label: Hear him out
options.reaction: A deposit. No strings. Well, a few strings.

advisors.line: I know that walk. I just can't place it.
Hey, I was going to buy the town.

game.title: Stare down the Stranger
game.flop: You blinked. He's measuring the curtains.

cards.text: The PTA talent show needs a judge. It's you. Forty children. One song. It's the same song. It's about you.

options.label: Judge honestly
options.reaction: 'Mayor Makes Children Cry.' Front page.

options.label: Everyone wins
options.reaction: Forty trophies. You're paying for forty trophies.

options.label: Send Dave
options.reaction: Dave ate a trophy. The kids loved it.

advisors.line: I'm doing the song. But louder.
Please be honest. I need this.

game.title: Keep time for forty children
game.flop: You lost the beat. Forty children lost it with you.

cards.text: Farmers are selling carrots in my car park. Carrots! For less than my carrots!

options.label: Protect the market
options.reaction: Enjoy your cheap carrots. I hope they're crunchy.

options.label: Ban the market
options.reaction: Thank you. Carrots are back to full price.

options.label: Market pays a fee
options.reaction: A carrot tax. I can live with that.

advisors.line: Those farmers are PTA dads.
A fee! Finally, some money coming in.

game.title: Slice the flying carrots
game.flop: You sliced the scarecrow. It has lodged an appeal.

cards.text: The station needs a police dog. We have one. His name is Sergeant Biscuit and he is afraid of crime, cats and Tuesdays.

options.label: Buy a braver dog
options.reaction: This one bit me. Perfect.

options.label: Therapy for the old dog
options.reaction: He's talking about his feelings. Well, barking.

options.label: One scared dog is plenty
options.reaction: He hid under my desk when you said that.

advisors.line: Can I pet him? Either him.
Dog therapy. In the budget. Under 'D'.

game.title: Run Biscuit through the course
game.flop: Biscuit lay down halfway. He has filed a complaint.

cards.text: Can the park have wifi? It's for homework. And for one game. Mostly the game.

options.label: Free park wifi
options.reaction: The password is 'frogday'.

options.label: Wifi with Chad's ads
options.reaction: It plays an ad every time you blink.

options.label: Go outside and play
options.reaction: We ARE outside.

advisors.line: I sell wifi. Why is it free?
Wifi is how the pigeons report back.

game.title: Type the wifi password
game.flop: The password is now 'aaaaaaaa'. Timmy cracked it.

cards.text: The City Hall basement is haunted. Or it has raccoons. Either way, I want to investigate.

options.label: Fund the ghost hunt
options.reaction: We found a cold spot. And a sandwich.

options.label: Seal the basement
options.reaction: You've sealed it. It knows you sealed it.

options.label: There's nothing down there
options.reaction: That's exactly what something down there would say.

advisors.line: Don't go in the basement. No reason. Just don't.
Ghosts sell papers.

game.title: Bust the basement ghosts
game.flop: They possessed the photocopier. It only prints 'BOO'.

cards.text: A heatwave is coming. Or a cold snap. It's one of those. Either way, the pool is cracked and full of Doug.

options.label: Fix the pool
options.reaction: It's snowing. But the pool looks great.

options.label: Sprinklers on Main Street
options.reaction: The shoppers are soaked. The children are thrilled.

options.label: Tell them to drink water
options.reaction: Hot, with a chance of angry.

advisors.line: Wet customers don't buy shoes.
The pool is where the PTA plots.

game.title: Fill the pool, bucket by bucket
game.flop: You filled the car park. Chad has a pool now.

cards.text: The bridge inspector says the bridge is 'mostly fine'. He wouldn't walk on it.

options.label: Repair the bridge
options.reaction: It doesn't wobble. I miss the wobble, a bit.

options.label: Promise repairs soon
options.reaction: Soon. I'll tell the bridge.

options.label: Put up a 'Good Luck' sign
options.reaction: The sign is very popular. The bridge is not.

advisors.line: I'm not driving the helicopter under it. Again.
'Bridge Fine, Says Man Running Away.'

game.title: Rebuild the bridge
game.flop: That was a load-bearing bolt. Was.

cards.text: I want a billboard on City Hall. Just my face. And the words 'TRUST CHAD'.

options.label: Allow the billboard
options.reaction: It lights up. You'll never need a lamp again.

options.label: A small one, round the back
options.reaction: Nobody can see it. I love it. I hate it.

options.label: No billboard
options.reaction: Then where do people look to trust me?

advisors.line: That's MY job. Putting faces on things.
It blinks in code.

game.title: Hang the billboard straight
game.flop: It's upside down. 'DAHC TSURT.' People prefer it.

cards.text: The school needs a crossing guard. The only volunteer is Gerald. He's already bought the hat. It's a tiny hat.

options.label: Hire a human
options.reaction: He has a little sign and everything.

options.label: Gerald it is
options.reaction: Traffic has stopped. All of it. For hours.

options.label: Children can look both ways
options.reaction: I'm putting that on a banner. With your name.

advisors.line: A goose cannot direct traffic. He has tried.
Honk. (He says he's qualified.)

game.title: Walk the children across
game.flop: You crossed alone. The children are still waving.

cards.text: A rival paper has started: The Whistle. Shut it down and The Bugle will adore you.

options.label: Shut down The Whistle
options.reaction: One paper. One voice. Mine.

options.label: Buy The Whistle
options.reaction: You own a newspaper now. It's mostly recipes.

options.label: A free press is good
options.reaction: Then read what The Whistle says about your hair.

advisors.line: The Whistle prints the real weather.
Two papers means two ad bills.

game.title: Sort real news from fake news
game.flop: You printed the fake ones. They sold better.

cards.text: I filed the paperwork. The town now legally owns the moon. We just need $9k for a flag and a very long pole.

options.label: Plant the flag
options.reaction: It's ours. Don't look at it without a permit.

options.label: Sell the moon to Chad
options.reaction: He's renamed it. It's 'Chad's Night Light' now.

options.label: Give the moon back
options.reaction: To who? Linda won't say. She just pointed up.

advisors.line: I'd pay good money for the moon. Bad money, too.
If we own it, are tides our fault?

game.title: Build a very long flagpole
game.flop: The pole reached a plane. The plane is annoyed.

cards.text: The town's emergency fund is four tons of cheese. Stored since 1987. I went down to count it. It counted me back.

options.label: Sell it, fast
options.reaction: Selling. Don't make eye contact with it.

win.text: A collector paid cash. He did not ask questions.

lose.text: The cheese refused to leave. We paid for the truck anyway.

options.label: Throw a cheese festival
options.reaction: Nine thousand people. One cheese. Zero survivors. Of the cheese.

options.label: Seal the vault
options.reaction: Sealed. It's knocking. Politely, so far.

advisors.line: I'm not arresting cheese. Again.
Can I meet it?

game.title: Slice the runaway cheese
game.flop: You sliced a firework. Cheese is now on the moon.

cards.text: The town's mimes are on strike. Nobody can tell. They'd like you to notice. They're pointing at you. Hard.

options.label: Notice them, with a banner
options.reaction: They're thrilled. I think. One of them is trapped in a box about it.

options.label: Negotiate in mime
options.reaction: You agreed to something. Nobody knows what. You shook an invisible hand.

options.label: Ignore the mimes
options.reaction: They're booing. Silently. It's somehow worse.

advisors.line: A silent protest. My reporters fell asleep.
One of them stole an invisible car.

game.title: Copy the mime
game.flop: You mimed something rude. By accident. Twice.

cards.text: A duck is running against Gerald for union president. They want you to judge the debate. In the pond. In a suit.

options.label: Back Gerald
options.reaction: HONK. (He says he'll remember this. He looks moved.)

options.label: Back the duck
options.reaction: The duck nods. Gerald stares. Nobody blinks.

win.text: The duck won. The geese accept it. The bugs are terrified.

lose.text: The duck lost and fled. Gerald knows what you did.

options.label: Stay out of bird politics
options.reaction: Both sides are disappointed. In unison. It's eerie.

advisors.line: Election interference. By a duck. I need a new form.
'FOWL PLAY.' I've waited my whole career.

game.title: Hold the ducks and geese apart
game.flop: They united. Against you.

cards.text: We dug up the 1974 time capsule! It's one note. It says 'THE TOWN OWES CHAD'S DAD $40'. Chad did the interest.

options.label: Settle with Chad
options.reaction: A pleasure. Dad would be proud. He's alive, he just wouldn't say it.

options.label: Bury it again, deeper
options.reaction: We buried it. Marge watched. Marge is writing.

options.label: Frame the note
options.reaction: It's in the museum now. Under 'Debts We Enjoy'.

advisors.line: Fifty years of interest. I've gone cold.
The capsule was the distraction. Dig under it.

game.title: Piece the note back together
game.flop: It now reads 'CHAD OWES THE TOWN'. Chad disagrees.

cards.text: I built a roundabout. It has no exits. Four cars have been in there since Tuesday. One has started a book club.

options.label: Rescue the drivers
options.reaction: They're out. Two of them went back in. They miss it.

options.label: Sell tickets to watch
options.reaction: The gift shop sells little cars that go nowhere.

options.label: It's working as intended
options.reaction: A fifth car just joined. They waved it in.

advisors.line: That's my delivery van. It's been 'ten minutes away' for days.
The book club is reading my husband's emails.

game.title: Drive out of the roundabout
game.flop: You waved a bus in. It has forty passengers.

cards.text: A pigeon has been signing papers at your desk for a week. I checked. Some of it is very good policy.

options.label: Hire the pigeon
options.reaction: It wants an office. And the office must have a ledge.

options.label: Let it sign today's stack
options.reaction: The pigeon is reading. It's nodding. It's signing.

win.text: It cut red tape and lowered rents. The pigeon is a genius.

lose.text: It sold the fire station. To another pigeon.

options.label: Evict the pigeon
options.reaction: It left. It took your stapler. It knew which one was yours.

advisors.line: Birds in government. Disgraceful. Anyway, how's the bin situation?
Its expenses are just 'bread'. I approved them.

game.title: Fend off the pigeon cabinet
game.flop: The pigeons voted you out. It was unanimous.

cards.text: There's a monster in the reservoir. It's very shy. I only know because it returned my umbrella.

options.label: Put it on the brochure
options.reaction: Tourists everywhere. The monster is hiding. It sent a note: 'please stop'.

options.label: Protect its privacy
options.reaction: It left a fish on your doorstep. I think you're friends now.

options.label: There is no monster
options.reaction: It heard you. It's sulking. The water tastes like sulking.

advisors.line: Monster burgers. Monster parking. I'm already printing.
It has my frisbee. It can keep it.

game.title: Photograph the monster
game.flop: Every photo is of a goose. The goose is flattered.

cards.text: I'm launching a rocket from the school field. It's safe. My guy says it's 'mostly up'.

options.label: Clear the launch
options.reaction: Ten, nine... where's the school going? Oh, that's just smoke.

win.text: It went up! Mostly! The town is on the news for a good reason.

lose.text: It went sideways. It's in the reservoir now.

options.label: Launch from your own lawn
options.reaction: My lawn? My lawn is imported.

options.label: No rockets near children
options.reaction: Fine. I'll launch something quieter. And bigger.

advisors.line: The PTA voted. We want to press the button.
I have no rocket laws. I'm writing some now.

game.title: Steer the rocket between buildings
game.flop: It went through Doug's kitchen. Doug was making toast.

cards.text: I gave some squirrels a loan. I was very tired. They put up acorns as collateral. They've defaulted.

options.label: Repossess the acorns
options.reaction: We own nine hundred acorns. The squirrels are outside. Watching.

options.label: Forgive the loan
options.reaction: They chittered. I think it was applause. One saluted.

options.label: Send Dave to collect
options.reaction: Dave came back with the money, three acorns and a black eye.

advisors.line: I know those squirrels. Don't lend to those squirrels.
Never take nuts as collateral. First rule of business.

game.title: Collect the acorn collateral
game.flop: You ate an acorn by accident. That was a payment.

cards.text: The Bugle is staging an opera about you. Four hours long. You die in act one. The rest is the funeral. It slaps.

options.label: Attend and applaud
options.reaction: You cried at your own funeral. That's tomorrow's photo.

options.label: Pay for rewrites
options.reaction: Now you live till act two. Then a goose gets you.

options.label: Ban the opera
options.reaction: Banned. So now it's a musical. A longer one.

advisors.line: HONK. (He's in it. He plays himself.)
The children are the chorus. They sing your crimes.

game.title: Clap in time at the opera
game.flop: You clapped at your own death. Then asked for more.

cards.text: We've been twinned with a town called Worse Town. They're visiting today. They already look disappointed.

options.label: Throw a welcome party
options.reaction: They loved it. They've asked to be adopted.

options.label: Show them the pothole
options.reaction: Their mayor wept. 'It's bigger than ours,' he said.

options.label: Lock the gates
options.reaction: They're sitting outside. They've started a worse town there.

advisors.line: Do they have money? Even bad money?
'WORSE TOWN: A REVIEW.' One star. Came back twice.

game.title: Shake every visitor's hand
game.flop: You sprained their mayor. It was his good hand.

cards.text: The geese have occupied the parking lot. They have a list of demands. It is mostly honking.

options.label: Pay them off in bread
options.reaction: The bread is acceptable. The parking lot is yours. For now.

options.label: Send Chief Barb
options.reaction: You sent the police. Against geese. Noted.

advisors.line: My car is in there.

game.title: Drive through the goose line
game.flop: You honked at them. They honked back. Louder.

cards.text: You found the ballots. Fine. I was mayor once. They voted for a goose instead. Help me, or expose me.

options.label: Expose him in The Bugle
options.reaction: Print it. I've been run out of town by worse. By geese.

options.label: Take his hush money
options.reaction: Smart. Wrong, but smart.

game.title: Match the old ballots
game.flop: You counted them. Gerald won again.

cards.text: The moon shines on my mansion. Your moon. I'm billing the town for trespassing light. $12k.

options.label: Pay the moonlight bill
options.reaction: Thank you. I've also invoiced the sun. That one's a courtesy.

options.label: Charge him for the view
options.reaction: A counter-invoice. Bold. My lawyers are putting on their night suits.

win.text: The judge laughed for a full minute. Chad paid up.

lose.text: His lawyers work in shifts. We lost. To moonlight.

game.title: Out-argue Chad's lawyers
game.flop: His lawyers work in shifts. You fell asleep.

cards.text: The reservoir monster has joined the PTA. It attends by gurgling. Its ideas are better than mine. I hate it.

options.label: Welcome the monster
options.reaction: It's treasurer now. The books are damp but balanced.

options.label: Monsters can't be parents
options.reaction: It has forty children. It showed us. We regret asking.

game.title: Gurgle the PTA minutes
game.flop: You gurgled a motion. It passed. You're treasurer.

cards.text: Chad's rocket landed. On the library. The books on the top floor are in orbit now. Returns are due Friday.

options.label: Rebuild the library
options.reaction: The new roof opens. In case the books come back.

options.label: Leave the rocket in
options.reaction: It's the reading rocket now. Story time has a countdown.

game.title: Catch the falling books
game.flop: You caught the overdue ones. With your face.

cards.text: State auditor. I'll need the books, the receipts, and an explanation for 'Dave: $900, shiny things'.

options.label: Open the books
options.reaction: Hm. Hmm. This page is a drawing of a goose. I'll allow it.

options.label: Bribe him with cheese
options.reaction: This is highly irregular. Is it aged? ...Proceed.

options.label: Let Dave handle the audit
options.reaction: Dave has taken the auditor 'for lunch'. Behind the diner.

win.text: The auditor signed everything. He looks happy. He smells of bins.

lose.text: The auditor found the second set of books. They're just more geese.

advisors.line: I'm not here. If he asks, I moved. To the sea.

game.title: Sort the receipts from the raccoons
game.flop: You handed him Dave's diary. He's read page one.

cards.text: Good news: I found the reservoir. Bad news: it's on Main Street. The monster says hello.

options.label: Rent the pumps
options.reaction: The street is dry. The shops smell like pond. They're calling it 'rustic'.

options.label: Rename it 'Little Venice'
options.reaction: Gondolas. Chad hates it. The tourists don't.

options.label: Wait for it to dry
options.reaction: It's not drying. A duck has opened a ferry.

advisors.line: My shoe shop is a lake. A LAKE.
HONK. (He's never been happier.)

game.title: Wade down Main Street
game.flop: You fell in. A duck rescued you. It's charging.

cards.text: Your diary leaked. Page four ranks every citizen from best to worst. The town is reading it out loud.

options.label: Apologise to everyone
options.reaction: You apologised in ranking order. That made it worse, then better.

options.label: Publish the whole diary
options.reaction: Printing all 300 pages. Even the poems. Oh no, the poems.

win.text: The poems are good. People are weeping. You rank them all first now.

lose.text: Page ninety is about Pam. Pam has read page ninety.

options.label: Blame the pigeon
options.reaction: The pigeon has released a statement. It's a better writer than you.

advisors.line: I was forty-first. FORTY-FIRST.

game.title: Shred the leaked pages
game.flop: Page ninety got away. Pam has read page ninety.

cards.text: Boss. The traffic cone is holding a rally. Four hundred people. It hasn't said one word. They love that about it.

options.label: Hold a bigger rally
options.reaction: Four hundred and one people. We counted Dave three times.

options.label: Debate the cone, live
options.reaction: You're at the podium. The cone is on its podium. Silence.

win.text: You won! The cone fell over. The crowd gasped, then cheered.

lose.text: The cone said nothing. It was devastating. You lost.

options.label: Have the cone towed
options.reaction: 'MAYOR TOWS RIVAL.' It's polling higher from the impound lot.

game.title: Out-cheer the cone
game.flop: You cheered alone. It echoed. The cone stood firm.

cards.text: Someone stole the 'Welcome to Town' sign. And the backup sign. Morale is low at the station.

options.label: Pay for overtime
options.reaction: We'll find that sign. Or a similar sign.

options.label: Blame the next town over
options.reaction: Classic them.

game.title: Catch the sign thieves
game.flop: You arrested the 'No Parking' sign. It confessed.

cards.text: Someone is counting cards at the library casino. It's the librarian. She's very good.

options.label: Ban Linda from blackjack
options.reaction: She's moved to roulette. She's good at that too.

options.label: Make her head of security
options.reaction: Nobody cheats now. She can smell it.

game.title: Count the cards
game.flop: Linda counted faster. She owns your watch now.

cards.text: We love you so much we went through your bins. You eat a LOT of string cheese. It's tomorrow's story.

options.label: Own it
options.reaction: 'Mayor: I Regret Nothing.' Perfect.

options.label: Bury the story
options.reaction: What story? Exactly.

game.title: Shred every Bugle in town
game.flop: You shredded Marge's birthday card. Marge noticed.

cards.text: The people adore you. So they'd like free ice cream. Every day. They said you'd say yes.

options.label: Free ice cream
options.reaction: They want sprinkles next. I'm just the messenger.

options.label: Say no nicely
options.reaction: They took it badly. One man lay down.

game.title: Scoop ice cream, not dynamite
game.flop: You served dynamite. The kid said it 'tasted spicy'.

cards.text: Business is so good I'd like to buy the town. Not all of it. Just the parts with roads.

options.label: Sell him Main Street
options.reaction: Welcome to Chad Street. Tolls start Monday.

options.label: Refuse
options.reaction: Everything has a price. I'll wait.

game.title: Hold on to Main Street
game.flop: He owns the pavement now. You're standing on his.

cards.text: With this much support I've started arresting people for jaywalking. And for walking. Thoughts?

options.label: Rein her in
options.reaction: Fine. Walking is legal again.

options.label: Let it ride
options.reaction: The streets have never been emptier.

game.title: Walk home without being arrested
game.flop: You were arrested for walking. And 'looking walky'.

cards.text: RARE. A golden goose has landed on City Hall. Gerald says it is his cousin. It lays one egg.

options.label: Sell the egg
options.reaction: HONK. (That was his cousin's egg.)

options.label: Give the egg to the town
options.reaction: The egg has its own parade now.

game.title: Catch the golden egg
game.flop: You dropped it. It bounced. That's suspicious.

cards.text: It's the day formerly known as Tuesday. Nobody knows what to wear. The bins weren't collected. Bins were Tuesday.

options.label: Give it back
options.reaction: Tuesday's back. People cheered. Then went to work.

options.label: Rename it Funday
options.reaction: Funday! Shops are shut. Nobody knows why. It's fun.

options.label: Hold firm
options.reaction: Firm. Like the bins. Which are full.

game.title: Teach the new weekday song
game.flop: You sang Tuesday by mistake. Twice.

cards.text: Geese have right of way. So now they direct traffic. Gerald has a whistle. He blows it at me. Specifically me.

options.label: Give Barb a whistle too
options.reaction: Two whistles. It's war. A very loud war.

options.label: Goose lanes on every road
options.reaction: The lanes are lovely. They're full of geese. Obviously.

options.label: Let Gerald run it
options.reaction: HONK. (He has promoted himself.)

game.title: Drive to work under goose law
game.flop: You hit a goose. Legally, you're now the goose.

cards.text: The tall hat tax has driven my hat abroad. It lives in a tax haven now. It sends postcards. I miss it.

options.label: Exempt top hats
options.reaction: My hat is coming home. I'm having it met at the airport.

options.label: Tax the postcards
options.reaction: Monstrous. Effective. Monstrous.

options.label: Hats are hats
options.reaction: Then I'll wear it upside down. As a bowl. Tax THAT.

game.title: Collect the hat tax
game.flop: You taxed a lampshade. It paid.

cards.text: A deputy dog has arrested me. For 'being a cat'. I'm not a cat. He's adamant. The paperwork is very good.

options.label: Overrule the dog
options.reaction: The dog accepts. He's watching me though.

options.label: Promote the dog
options.reaction: Sergeant Biscuit is chief now. I report to a dog.

options.label: Let justice take its course
options.reaction: I'm in a cell. It's cosy. Biscuit brought me a stick.

game.title: Chase the deputy dog
game.flop: You fell over. The dog arrested you too.

cards.text: Since the sigh tax, nobody sighs. They just... hold it in. The whole town is about to pop. I can feel it.

options.label: Declare a free sigh day
options.reaction: Four thousand sighs at noon. A window broke.

options.label: Raise the sigh tax
options.reaction: Now they sigh in whispers. It's eerie. It's profitable.

options.label: Sigh for them
options.reaction: You sighed for an hour. It cost you $360.

game.title: Hold in the town's sigh
game.flop: You sighed first. It echoed for a week.

campaign.text: Election day. The town knows a goose won last time. Run on honesty, or run from it?

options.label: 'At least I'm not a goose'
options.reaction: Gerald heard. Gerald is at the window.

options.label: Promise a recount
options.reaction: Brave. If Gerald wins again, we're moving.

options.label: Big rally
options.reaction: We ordered balloons. So many balloons.

options.label: Call in every Favor
options.reaction: Phones are ringing. People owe you.

campaign.text: Election day. One last push. What's the plan, boss? We believe in you. All three of us.

options.label: Big rally
options.reaction: We ordered balloons. So many balloons.

options.label: Call in every Favor
options.reaction: Phones are ringing. People owe you.

options.label: Attack ad about the cone
options.reaction: The cone did not respond. Classic cone.

options.label: Just be yourself
options.reaction: Risky. We love it.

objectives.text: Find out what is in the basement

cliffhangers: Tomorrow: Stormy Steve has a forecast. He's whispering it.
Tomorrow: someone has left you a note. The handwriting is very neat.
Tomorrow: The Bugle has a visitor. A large one.
Tomorrow: the basement. Bring a torch.
Tomorrow: the debate. Your opponent is orange and says nothing.
Tomorrow: the voters decide. Wear the good tie.
recallEndings: The town voted to replace you with a traffic cone. The cone declined. You're Acting Mayor.
You were chased out by a crowd. Then chased back in, because nobody else wanted the job.
The recall passed. The paperwork was eaten by a goose. You're still here, sort of.
The town's wallet is empty. It also has a moth in it. You're Acting Mayor now.

outcomes.text: Dave solved it. Nobody knows how. Dave included.
Dave handled it from inside a bin. It mostly worked.
Dave found $9,000 in a hedge and called it 'the budget'.
Dave traded the problem for something shiny.
Dave hissed at everyone until they left.
Dave gave a press conference. All three of him spoke at once.
Dave fell asleep on the paperwork. The problem got bored and left.
Dave knows a guy. The guy is also a raccoon.
Dave ate the request.
Dave's plan was brilliant. Please stop asking him to explain it.
The trench coat came open mid-meeting. Everyone agreed to say nothing.
Dave washed the paperwork in the fountain. It's very clean now.
Dave stood on his own shoulders and gave a speech. People clapped.
Dave shook hands with Chad. Chad counted his fingers afterwards.
Dave borrowed Chief Barb's badge. She wants it back. And an apology.
Dave gave Marge an exclusive. It was mostly chittering. She printed it.
Dave billed the town for 'lunch'. Lunch was a whole buffet.
Dave signed it with a paw print. Legally, that counts.
Dave fixed it at 3 am. Something is missing from every bin in town.
Dave panicked and split into three. Each one did a third of the job.
Dave threw a gala. In a skip. It was the event of the season.

absence: Dave governed from a shopping trolley.
Dave signed everything. With a paw print.
Dave held office hours at 3 am, behind the diner.
Dave moved the mayor's desk into a bin. He says it's 'more efficient'.

decrees.name: The Tall Hat Tax
decrees.text: A tax on any hat taller than six inches. Chad owns a top hat with a second, smaller hat on it.
decrees.reaction: You're taxing my hat's hat? That hat has a hat fund.

decrees.name: A Tax on Sighing
decrees.text: Ten cents per audible sigh. The town sighs about four thousand times a day. Mostly at you.
decrees.reaction: I sighed when I read it. That's ten cents. I'm sighing again.

decrees.name: The Rain Tax
decrees.text: Citizens pay for rain they use. Steve will go door to door asking who got wet.
decrees.reaction: Did you get wet today? Be honest. I have a clipboard.

decrees.name: Whistling Licences
decrees.text: Whistling needs a licence. Jaunty whistling needs the premium licence.
decrees.reaction: I've already fined a kettle.

decrees.name: Sell Pothole Naming Rights
decrees.text: Businesses can sponsor a pothole. First up: 'Kevin, brought to you by Chad'.
decrees.reaction: 'This Pothole Sponsored By Regret.' I'd buy that.

decrees.name: Cancel Tuesdays
decrees.text: Tuesdays are abolished. The week goes Monday, Second Monday, Wednesday.
decrees.reaction: The PTA meets on Tuesdays. Met. I have feelings about this.

decrees.name: Mandatory Compliments
decrees.text: Every conversation must begin with a compliment. Sarcasm is a fine of $5.
decrees.reaction: Lovely decree. Your hair looks like a decision. Is that right?

decrees.name: Geese Have Right of Way
decrees.text: On roads, pavements, and inside shops. Especially inside shops.
decrees.reaction: HONK. (He's crossing the road. Slowly. On purpose.)

decrees.name: Left Turns Only
decrees.text: All right turns are banned. To go right, citizens turn left three times.
decrees.reaction: Traffic is a spiral now. A beautiful, legal spiral.

decrees.name: All Dogs Are Deputies
decrees.text: Every dog in town is sworn in. They get badges. The badges are on their collars.
decrees.reaction: Forty-one new officers. Thirty-nine good boys. Two under review.

decrees.name: Free Soup Fridays
decrees.text: Free soup for everyone, every Friday. Nobody asked what kind. Nobody ever does.
decrees.reaction: It's grey soup. They love it. Don't ask what's in it. I didn't.

decrees.name: Compulsory Nap Hour
decrees.text: The whole town naps from two to three. Shops close. Crime also naps, probably.
decrees.reaction: I'm not tired. I'm not ti... zzz.

decrees.name: An Official Town Smell
decrees.text: The town adopts an official smell. Linda proposes 'old library, with a hint of soup'.
decrees.reaction: It's in a bottle now. Don't open it indoors. Or outdoors.

decrees.name: Chad Appreciation Day
decrees.text: A parade for Chad. He provides the float. The float is him, on a larger him.
decrees.reaction: I didn't ask for this. I did fund it, plan it and name it.

decrees.name: Ban Bad News
decrees.text: The Bugle may only print good news. Today's headline: 'Nothing On Fire (Much)'.
decrees.reaction: 'Mayor Bans Sadness.' I'm allowed to print that. It's good news.

decrees.name: A Curfew for Bins
decrees.text: All bins must be indoors by nine. Deputy Dave has asked to speak against it.
decrees.reaction: This is an attack on... on nightlife. On my nightlife.

decrees.name: Count Every Frog
decrees.text: An official frog census. Timmy will lead it. He has a net and no plan.
decrees.reaction: Four hundred and six! Or the same frog four hundred times.

decrees.name: Billboards Facing the Moon
decrees.text: Rent out ad space that only the moon can see. Chad says the moon is 'an untapped market'.
decrees.reaction: The moon has not bought anything yet. Give it time.

decrees.name: A Longer Town Anthem
decrees.text: The anthem gains nineteen verses. Verse twelve is just the bin schedule.
decrees.reaction: The children know all nineteen. They sing it at me. In shops.

decrees.name: The Door Tax
decrees.text: A tax on doors. Citizens with more than one door pay extra. Windows are watching nervously.
decrees.reaction: People are leaving through windows. Technically, that's free.

decrees.name: Mandatory Waving
decrees.text: Every citizen must wave at every other citizen. The town's arms are tired by noon.
decrees.reaction: I waved at a bus. The bus waved back. I think.

decrees.name: The Puddle Levy
decrees.text: A small fee for stepping in puddles. Steve will measure each puddle personally.
decrees.reaction: Big puddle on Elm Street. That one's a premium puddle.

decrees.name: A Golden Statue of You
decrees.text: Forty feet. Gold. Your face. It is slightly bigger than Chad's statue. Chad is aware.
decrees.reaction: It's lovely. It's bigger than mine. I'm going to need a minute.

decrees.name: Shops Open All Night
decrees.text: Every shop stays open all night. Nobody needs a sofa at 3am. They buy one anyway.
decrees.reaction: Profits up. Sleep down. Worth it.

catastrophes.text: THE GREAT GOOSE UPRISING. Ten thousand geese have taken Main Street. They have a flag. They have demands. They have the bakery.

options.label: Negotiate with Gerald
options.reaction: HONK. (Terms accepted. You now owe him a lake.)

options.label: Send in Barb
options.reaction: Barb has a megaphone and a broom. It's a stalemate.

options.label: Let them have the bakery
options.reaction: The geese run the bakery now. The bread is mostly feathers.

stages.title: Round up the first wave
stages.flop: The first wave rounded you up instead.

stages.title: Hold back the flying V
stages.flop: They flew through City Hall. In formation.

stages.title: Rebuild the bakery
stages.flop: It's a nest now. A very large nest.

game.title: Round up the first wave
game.flop: The first wave rounded you up instead.

catastrophes.text: THE CHEESE VAULT HAS BURST. Four tons of 1987 cheese are rolling downhill toward the school. It has momentum. It has intent.

options.label: Build a cracker wall
options.reaction: A cracker wall. The cheese stopped. It looks hungry.

options.label: Evacuate and sell tickets
options.reaction: Front row seats. Splash zone extra.

options.label: Let it roll
options.reaction: It rolled through town and out the other side. Then it came back.

stages.title: Cut through the cheese wall
stages.flop: You cut a fuse. The cheese now has a fuse.

stages.title: Leap the cheese wheels
stages.flop: A wheel got you. You're a wedge now, emotionally.

stages.title: Catch the evacuating children
stages.flop: You caught a cheese. It's been enrolled.

game.title: Cut through the cheese wall
game.flop: You cut a fuse. The cheese now has a fuse.

catastrophes.text: KEVIN HAS GROWN. The pothole is now a sinkhole. It ate the post office. Kevin has a post office now. Kevin is getting mail.

options.label: Fill Kevin with concrete
options.reaction: Kevin is sealed. We can hear him. Sulking.

options.label: Make Kevin an attraction
options.reaction: Queues round the block. Two tourists fell in. They're fine. Kevin's fine.

options.label: Move the town to the left
options.reaction: We moved. Kevin followed.

stages.title: Drive round the cracks
stages.flop: You fell into a small Kevin. Kevin Junior.

stages.title: Plug the new holes
stages.flop: The holes are winning. They've unionised.

stages.title: Rebuild the post office
stages.flop: The post office leans into Kevin. Kevin approves.

game.title: Drive round the cracks
game.flop: You fell into a small Kevin. Kevin Junior.

catastrophes.text: MY ROCKET HAS COME BACK. It wasn't supposed to. It's circling the town, beeping. Beeping is bad, right? Asking for me.

options.label: Shoot it down
options.reaction: Barb hit it with a shoe. It worked. Don't ask how.

options.label: Land it on Chad's house
options.reaction: Direct hit. Chad wasn't home. His other house was.

options.label: Ask the pigeon
options.reaction: The pigeon flew up and had a word. Unclear what word.

stages.title: Chase it in the helicopter
stages.flop: You chased the moon by mistake. Lovely view.

stages.title: Knock down the debris
stages.flop: A bolt landed in the mayor's soup. Your soup.

stages.title: Rebuild what it hit
stages.flop: You rebuilt the library upside down. Read from the bottom.

game.title: Chase it in the helicopter
game.flop: You chased the moon by mistake. Lovely view.

initiatives.name: Kiss babies at the market
initiatives.text: Classic politics. Tap the babies. Not the geese. The geese will bite back.

game.title: Kiss the babies, dodge the geese
game.flop: You kissed a goose. It kissed back. Hard.

clean.text: Twelve babies, zero geese. Pam wept.

initiatives.name: Busk for the budget
initiatives.text: Stand on Main Street and play. Every coin helps. Doug has brought a hat. It's his good hat.

game.title: Play the town anthem
game.flop: You played the bin schedule. Nobody tipped.

initiatives.name: Race Chad to the bank
initiatives.text: Chad bets you can't beat his limo to the bank. Winner gets the town's business. Loser buys lunch.

game.title: Race Chad down Main Street
game.flop: You lost to a limo with a chef in it.

clean.text: You won. Chad is in awe. And in debt.

sloppy.text: A draw. Chad calls it a merger.

flop.text: You lost. And bought lunch. Lobster.

initiatives.name: Ride along with Chief Barb
initiatives.text: Barb's on patrol. She wants you in the car. The siren's been on since Tuesday.

game.title: Hold the radio, dodge the cones
game.flop: You arrested Barb. She allowed it, then didn't.

initiatives.name: Fly the Bugle blimp
initiatives.text: The Bugle has a blimp. Nobody can fly it. You're the mayor. Marge says that's basically the same thing.

game.title: Fly the blimp over the fair
game.flop: The blimp now lives in a tree. It seems happy.

clean.text: Aerial photos! Front page all week.

initiatives.name: Lead the goose parade
initiatives.text: Gerald has asked you, personally, to lead the parade. He's ironed his sash. He's ironed YOUR sash.

game.title: Lead the geese down Main Street
game.flop: The geese led you. Into the river.

clean.text: A perfect V down Main Street. Honking, tears.

initiatives.name: Judge the pie contest
initiatives.text: Forty pies. One mayor. Timmy says some of the pies are "experimental". He made those.

game.title: Slice and taste every pie
game.flop: You ate Timmy's experimental pie. It was a firework.

clean.text: Every pie tasted. Every baker happy.

initiatives.name: Defend the town from pigeons
initiatives.text: The pigeons are massing on the library roof. Linda says this is phase two. She won't say what phase one was.

game.title: Hold the library roof
game.flop: The pigeons took the roof. And the clock.

flop.text: The pigeons have a flag now.

initiatives.name: Shake hands at the factory
initiatives.text: Chad wants a photo of you shaking hands with every worker. There are two hundred. Hands are a resource.

game.title: Shake two hundred hands
game.flop: You sprained the foreman.

clean.text: Two hundred handshakes. A Favor owed.

initiatives.name: Host a Town TV phone-in
initiatives.text: You, a phone, and the whole town calling. Marge has the delay button. She won't use it.

game.title: Match callers to their complaints
game.flop: You answered a goose. Live.

clean.text: Charming! A Favor from the network.

initiatives.name: Patrol the bins at night
initiatives.text: Dave says the bins need watching. He says this from inside a bin. He suggests you do the other bins.

game.title: Shoo the raccoons, spare the kids
game.flop: You shooed a child. He was taking out the bins.

clean.text: Not one bin raided. Dave seemed... disappointed.

flop.text: The raccoons now run the bins. Dave won't comment.

initiatives.name: Run the charity fun run
initiatives.text: The PTA fun run. 5k. You said "fun" in an interview. They took that personally.

game.title: Finish the fun run
game.flop: You finished last. Behind a man in a cheese costume.

flop.text: Taken away on a stretcher. A slow one.

initiatives.name: High-score night at the arcade
initiatives.text: Chad's arcade, one night only. The town watches you play. Losing to a child would be very bad. There are many children.

game.title: Set the high score
game.flop: You lost to Timmy. He did a dance.

clean.text: New high score! The town chants your name.

flop.text: Timmy beat you. He told everyone.

initiatives.name: Lead the town choir
initiatives.text: The choir needs a leader for the festival. They sing whatever you conduct. Conduct well.

game.title: Lead the choir in time
game.flop: The choir sang three different songs at once.

clean.text: Standing ovation. A Favor from the PTA.

initiatives.name: Help the goslings across
initiatives.text: Gerald's nephews need to cross Main Street. All nineteen. In a line. Traffic is not slowing down.

game.title: Get the goslings across
game.flop: A gosling took the bus. It's in Worse Town now.

clean.text: All nineteen across. Gerald saluted with a wing.

flop.text: Gerald has started a petition about you.

initiatives.name: Sort out lost property
initiatives.text: The lost property box has been 'lost' since 1991. Linda found it. Some of it is still warm.

game.title: Keep the treasures, bin the ghosts
game.flop: You kept a ghost. It's in your coat now.

flop.text: You found the 1991 mayor. Still in there.

low:people.title: Run Out by the PTA
low:people.text: Pam read out your record at a meeting. It took four hours. Nobody left. Then everybody came for you, with clipboards.

low:business.title: Bought Out
low:business.text: Chad bought City Hall, the chair you were sitting in, and the chair's opinion of you. You were escorted out by a man he also bought.

low:law.title: Arrested by Barb
low:law.text: Chief Barb arrested you for 'general crimes'. The trial was short. The judge was Barb. The jury was Barb's helicopter.

low:press.title: Front Page Disgrace
low:press.text: The Bugle printed your face with the word 'NO' under it. Every day. In bigger letters. The town took the hint.

high:people.title: Carried Off by Fans
high:people.text: The people love you so much they carried you on their shoulders. Out of town. They haven't put you down. It's been a week.

high:business.title: Acquired
high:business.text: Chad loves you so much he acquired you. You are now a subsidiary. Your title is Mayor (Brand Partner).

high:law.title: Made Permanent Deputy
high:law.text: Barb respects you so much she deputised you. For life. You now live at the station. There's a cot. It's mostly fine.

high:press.title: Turned Into a Column
high:press.text: Marge loves you so much she gave you a column. Then a second. Then you were the paper. You can't stop writing.

bankrupt.title: The Town Is Broke
bankrupt.text: The treasury is one button and a moth. Doug has gone to live in a tree. The bank repossessed the word 'Mayor'.

term:won.title: Re-elected
term:won.text: The town has spoken. Mostly in honks. You're mayor for another week, heaven help everyone.

term:landslide.title: Landslide
term:landslide.text: Sixty per cent or more. The cone has retired. Gerald sent a card. It just says 'HONK' but it's heartfelt.

term:lost.title: Voted Out
term:lost.text: The traffic cone will be sworn in at noon. It has promised to do nothing. People found that refreshing.

term:early.title: Recalled for Good
term:early.text: Three recalls. The town has filed you under 'Never Again'. Dave has taken the desk. He's put it in a bin.
